{{Top|leg}}
The '''Bounty Post''' was the only permanent structure in the [[Salovan's Souk|Souk]]. It allowed individuals to post or look for [[Bounty/Legends|bounties]]. Every user was given a unique identification number, and the Bounty Post took a finder's fee off of paid bounty.<ref name="Scum and Villainy">[[Scum and Villainy (sourcebook)|''Scum and Villainy'']]</ref>

It allowed people who were placing bounties to avoid working directly with the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|hunter]]. It was also fully networked with other bounty posts in other [[Shadowport/Legends|shadowports]] across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. This allowed it to have a wide range of jobs and include detailed data such as maps, holos or specific biological information.<ref name="Scum and Villainy" />
